identification: Seven Australian fortified wine bottles, 1960s-80s: Springton Wines & Vineyards 1962 Vintage Port (26 fl oz, Eden Valley SA); Kaiser Stuhl 1973 Vintage Port commemorating opening of the Chateau winery 8 March 1974 (boxed); Kaiser Stuhl Pottery Port 750ml stoneware jug (cork degraded); Drayton's Father's Port decanter-style bottle (boxed); Wolf Blass Portrait Port (20th anniversary, boxed); Renmano Cromwell Tawny Port 750ml 18%; one Russian/other dry red in cellophane. Common commercial bottlings, fill levels not clear.
